digest.component_or_area: Event-driven metrics derivation over ticket event store
propositions: New read-only derivation functions must read from raw event files (sorted, compaction-retired included) for multi-occurrence metrics (attempts per ticket, rework windows, reopen counts) where compiled state retains only terminal values.
Metrics requiring only terminal state (first_pass_rate, revert_recovery) must read from reduce_ticket() compiled output where single values suffice, avoiding redundant raw event scans.

attempts_per_ticket must count distinct session claims via open→in_progress STATUS edges; first_pass_rate must identify tickets never reopened by checking absence of last_reopened_at; rework_within_days(n) must measure closed→open→closed edges within n days from raw timestamps.
revert_recovery must filter reverts by target_event_type, counting only substantive reverts (STATUS or COMMITS), not COMMENT or LINK reverts.
Empty date ranges must return None (Unavailable); populated ranges with zero qualifying events must return 0 (measured zero), distinguishing no-data from zero-signal.
